title: Potential change: local government approval of site area variations up to 5% through a development approval
text: Potential change: Local governments to have ability to approve variations to minimum and/or average site area up to 5 per cent through a development approval. Refer to Information Sheet 5: Lot size and density.
notes: from: ch3 M4.1.2 (pink callout recorded there in notes only). Flagged potential change (pink box, p49); no clause text. Says 'minimum and/or average' although apartments have no minimum. Information Sheet 5. Nothing to test.
